description: Strudel Node Connector & Sequencing Schema - Directed Acyclic Signal Graph with enhanced constraints

source.description: Sound generators - must be at the start of any chain

rhythmic.description: Time slicing & repeats (slow, fast, euclid, chop, stutter)

Note.title: Note
Note.description: Musical note pattern generator using note names

pattern.label: Note Pattern
pattern.description: Mini-notation pattern of note names (c4, eb5, etc.)

s.title: Sound Pattern
s.description: Creates a pattern from sound sample names

Instrument.title: Instrument
Instrument.description: Sound generator for melodic instrument samples

Sequence.title: Sequence
Sequence.description: Combines patterns in sequence (one after another)

Group.title: Group
Group.description: Groups patterns with selectable combination mode

Chop.title: Chop
Chop.description: Time slicing for granular effects (slices events into parts)

connectionRules.note: Only one Chop per linear execution chain
Only one Stutter per linear execution chain

LPF.title: Low Pass Filter
LPF.description: Filters high frequencies, allows low frequencies to pass

frequency.label: Cutoff Frequency
frequency.description: Filter cutoff frequency in Hz (50-20000), can be pattern or control

HPF.title: High Pass Filter
HPF.description: Filters low frequencies, allows high frequencies to pass

BPF.title: Band Pass Filter
BPF.description: Allows a frequency band to pass, cuts low and high

Delay.title: Delay
Delay.description: Time-based delay effect (echo) - global per orbit

connectionRules.note: Multiple patterns on same orbit share delay settings

time.label: Delay Time
time.description: Delay time in seconds or cycles

Reverb.title: Reverb
Reverb.description: Spatial reverb effect - global per orbit

connectionRules.note: Multiple patterns on same orbit share reverb settings

amount.label: Gain Amount
amount.description: Volume multiplier (can be pattern or constant)

Crush.title: Bit Crush
Crush.description: Reduces bit depth for digital distortion

bits.label: Bit Depth
bits.description: Number of bits (1-16), lower = more distortion

Vowel.title: Vowel Filter
Vowel.description: Formant filter to make sounds resemble vocal vowels

Distort.title: Distortion
Distort.description: Signal distortion effect with optional post-gain

Jux.title: Juxtapose
Jux.description: Splits pattern into stereo channels with different transforms

Rev.title: Reverse
Rev.description: Reverses the order of events in a pattern

Shuffle.title: Shuffle
Shuffle.description: Randomly reorders events in a pattern

probability.label: Probability
probability.description: Chance to apply transform (0-1). Default 0.7 = often

probability.label: Probability
probability.description: Chance to apply transform (0-1). Default 0.5 = sometimes

probability.label: Probability
probability.description: Chance to apply transform (0-1). Default 0.25 = rarely

LFO.title: LFO
LFO.description: Low Frequency Oscillator - generates continuous control signal

rate.label: Rate
rate.description: Oscillation speed in Hz or cycles

Range.title: Range Map
Range.description: Maps control signal to a min-max range

Random.title: Random
Random.description: Random value generator for control signals

StepSeq.title: Step Sequencer
StepSeq.description: Programmable step sequencer for control values

bank.title: Bank Selection
bank.description: Sets the sound bank/kit for drum sounds

dec.title: Decay
dec.description: Sets the decay time for drum sounds

slow.title: Slow
slow.description: Slows down pattern by a factor (divides time)

fast.title: Fast
fast.description: Speeds up pattern by a factor (multiplies time)

value.label: Add Value
value.description: Value to add to each event

Transform.title: Transform
Transform.description: Generic pattern transformation (chop, stutter, slow, fast, rev, etc.)

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Applies musical scale to pattern - converts numbers to notes

struct.title: Structure
struct.description: Applies rhythmic structure pattern (using x, ~ symbols)

whenmod.title: When Modulo
whenmod.description: Applies transformation when cycle modulo matches

off.title: Offset
off.description: Adds offset timing to pattern (superimpose with delay)

forbiddenConnections.reason: Source nodes cannot receive pattern inputs
Cannot connect source to source (ambiguous source)
Effects cannot feed into source nodes
Wrapper nodes should wrap final patterns

enforcedRules.description: Exactly one source node per linear chain
Wrapper nodes must be at end of chain
Connections must follow increasing execution stage priority
Nodes with maxPerChain limit cannot exceed that count in any linear chain
Container/wrapper children must match declared childTypes
minChildren and maxChildren must be respected
Node graph must be a directed acyclic graph
Control signals can only connect to properties with canBeControl:true

notes.maxPerChain: Limits how many times a node type can appear in a single linear execution chain from source to wrapper. Enforced at connection time.
notes.childTypeStrict: When true, children must exactly match one of the childTypes values. When false, any pattern-type child is accepted.
notes.wraps: If true, this node is a wrapper and must be at the end of a chain (no outputs to other pattern nodes).
notes.orbitAware: Nodes marked orbitAware share state per orbit; connecting multiple patterns to same orbit may cause interference.
notes.controlSocket: Properties with canBeControl:true can receive control signals.controlIn socket maps to specific property.
